This manual describes three ways to submit a dataset to BigPicture. Each ends
with a validated dataset uploaded to the BigPicture archive.

::: {.callout-important}
## Access required

Every path needs access to the private BigPicture repositories and container
images. Request access via the [servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}})
before you start.
:::

## Choose a path

| Path | Curation UI | Set-up |
|------|-------------|--------|
| [**1. bp-submission-pipeline**](bp-submission-pipeline/prerequisites.qmd) | Yes | The pipeline connects the components (Make and Docker Compose). Steps A–J. |
| [**2. Direct components**](direct-components/index.qmd) | Yes | You run and connect the components yourself. |
| [**3. Direct upload (sda-cli)**](direct-upload/prerequisites.qmd) | No | You prepare the metadata by hand and upload with `sda-cli`. |

The curation UI (`bigpicture-slidetap`) is a browser interface for reviewing and
correcting metadata before submission.

## Path 1 in stages

- **Set up (A–G):** install and configure the pipeline.
- **Test run (H–J):** submit a test dataset to staging.
- **Go to production:** switch to the production archive.

Most steps end with a *Verify* box with the expected output.

## Terminology

[Key concepts](key-concepts.qmd) lists the terms used in this manual.
